messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still while the camera orbits around her, showing her front, side, and back views.","camera":"A slow, smooth 360-degree orbit around the character at roughly waist-to-chest height, keeping her centered in a full-body frame.","clothing":"A gray military-style uniform with a buttoned tunic, a gold belt, a small gold chest insignia, matching gray trousers with a white side stripe, and dark brown shoes.","hair_color":"White or very light gray.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair close to the scalp.","identity":"A 3D-rendered Black woman with a slim build, shown in full body from head to toe.","scene":"An outdoor stone courtyard with cracked paving, stacked wooden crates, large pipes, and weathered tan walls under bright sunlight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a dark neon-lit interior to a sunlit outdoor stone courtyard with cracked paving, wooden crates, pipes, and tan walls, closely matching the reference. The person remains a 3D-rendered Black woman with short white hair and a gray military-style uniform, and the camera continues a similar full-body 360-degree orbit. Lighting on the person changed from cool neon to warm sunlight.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the futuristic neon environment with the outdoor stone courtyard from the reference, changing only the environment and its lighting on the person while preserving identity, appearance, expression, action, camera framing, and movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was preserved exactly, since the face is small and not clearly visible in most frames.
unexpected_changes: The uniform appears more clearly gray in the new lighting, whereas it looked darker and more purple in the source, though this is consistent with the requested lighting change.
